annotations.title: Change the plan, notifications and brands

description:
The account as Settings → Plan and → Notifications, and the brand switcher, keep it (read them with get_settings plan and notifications). A plan change charges or credits the card on file, for an admin's agent. Starting the plan is the person's own click: the first card in Stripe's Checkout, and ending a free trial early with Start my plan now (get_settings plan gives the link), as are signing in and who gets access. What a trial holds back (sending email, the mailbox, the whole allowances) opens when the plan starts. The plan is amounts: articles (Sightkick's a month), prompts, aiModels, keywordSearches, contactsFound, managedInbox, interval (month or year), each on its steps (get_settings plan); what's left out stays.
action:
- preview_plan(articles?, prompts?, aiModels?, keywordSearches?, contactsFound?, managedInbox?, interval?): What a change would charge today and the price per month after it, without changing anything. A change that lowers the bill waits for the renewal.
- change_plan(articles?, prompts?, aiModels?, keywordSearches?, contactsFound?, managedInbox?, interval?): Change the amounts or the cycle. A bill that rises or holds changes today, the difference charged; one that falls is booked for the renewal, nothing charged. On a trial it applies at once, nothing charged before the trial ends. payLink: the card wants the person to confirm.
- undo_downgrade: Take back a downgrade booked for the renewal: the plan stays as paid for, nothing charged.
- pause_plan(months): Pause a monthly plan for 1 to 3 months from its renewal: nothing billed and Sightkick's work stops meanwhile, everything set up stays.
- resume_plan: Keep the plan: take back a cancel, or end a pause today.
- cancel_plan(reason, comment?): Cancel at the renewal, with why (reason: price, results, technical, priority, switching or other, and a comment): everything runs until then, nothing more charged, resume_plan takes it back. A plan in its pause ends at once.
- notifications(email?, positiveReplies?, weeklyBrief?, nudges?): When Sightkick emails the owner: email (empty clears it, and every notification goes quiet), positiveReplies, weeklyBrief, nudges. What's left out stays.
- create_brand(websiteUrl, name?): A new brand for the person you act for, on its website (name: the site's when left out). They finish its setup in the app (the analysis, the review, the trial with their card); connect to it to work there.
- delete_brand: Delete this workspace's brand, for an admin's agent: its plan ends at once with nothing refunded, Google and the mailboxes are disconnected, and every page, prompt, thread and number Sightkick holds for it is deleted. The site keeps what was published to it. This connection stops with it. Can't be undone.
